changes: Optional page icon, coverFileId and archivedAt metadata; page.update accepts icon/coverFileId.
Workspace snapshot and native file-handle facade are Phase1 implementation adapters over canonical schemas.
block.move provides guarded existing-block reparenting and cross-page moves, retaining identity.
tasks.ensure atomically establishes the one system Tasks collection; record.clearValue explicitly removes optional values.
Snapshot, backlinks, job listing, history preview, restoration and recovery-point requests have bounded typed contracts.
Go optional-nullable fields preserve absent versus explicit-null intent through typed command hashing and round trips.
memory.update and memory.setStatus support reviewed edits and disabling/superseding approved memory without copying current task/database state.
transcript_segment entity references support guarded history restore and consistent canonical revision reporting.
Phase 2 adapters implement import previews/commits/portable export, derived FTS/semantic indexing, local AI review, recording and complete staged native restore.

Additive runtime tables retain import evidence, search projections, AI conversations/proposals, capture journals, recovery previews and explicit retention settings. Historical memory source IDs survive block deletion.

Phase 6 optional P2 contracts add guarded database configuration/forms/row buttons, page display preferences, bounded graph/OCR/review queries, and reviewed personal actions. Hosting reuses service transport 1 and verified snapshots with a durable source-owner fence.
compatibility: Numeric service transport remains version 1 and the canonical domain snapshot remains 1.0.0. The packaged UI and kernel upgrade together. Old property values without sufficient schema evidence produce explicit restore conflicts; unsupported import/export semantics remain readable and raw. Immutable base SQL migrations 1 and 2 remain unchanged; runtime migrations and CREATE IF NOT EXISTS tables are additive.
